look.style: A clean 2D Japanese anime illustration, like official character art for a TV anime: crisp confident line art of even weight, cel shading with one soft shadow tone and a few sharp highlights, flat clean colors, anime-style eyes with clear highlights, a small simplified nose and mouth, hair drawn in smooth clumps with glossy highlight bands. Fabric folds drawn as simple lines.
look.clean: Plain pure white background, evenly lit, with at most a faint soft shadow under the feet. Exactly one character, empty hands, no props, no text, no watermark.
look.neg: photograph, photorealistic, realistic skin texture, pores, film grain, 3D render, CGI, semi-realistic, painterly, watercolor, sketch, rough lines, messy lines, heavy shading, gradient background, character sheet, multiple views, chibi, super deformed
